import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by 4K capability
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
colors = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
for has_4k in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['has_video_4k'] == has_4k]
    label = '4K Video' if has_4k == 1 else 'No 4K'
    ax2.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], alpha=0.5, 
               c=colors[has_4k], label=label, s=30)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price\n(4K Capability)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Camera evolution over years - average megapixels
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
year_mp = df.groupby('model_year')['megapixels'].mean().sort_index()
ax3.plot(year_mp.index, year_mp.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=4, color='#3498db')
ax3.fill_between(year_mp.index, year_mp.values, alpha=0.3, color='#3498db')
ax3.set_title('Average Megapixels\nOver Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Brand market share
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(brand_counts))
ax4.pie(brand_counts.values, labels=brand_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=colors_pie, textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax4.set_title('Market Share by Brand\n(Top 8)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Body type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax5.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color='#9b59b6')
ax5.set_title('Camera Count by\nBody Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Weight vs Price by sensor type
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
top_sensors = df['sensor_type'].value_counts().head(4).index
df_filtered = df[df['sensor_type'].isin(top_sensors)]
for sensor in top_sensors:
    subset = df_filtered[df_filtered['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax6.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], 
               label=sensor, alpha=0.6, s=40)
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Sensor Type (Top 4)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.legend(fontsize=9, loc='upper right')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Max ISO distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax7.hist(df['max_iso'], bins=30, color='#e67e22', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_title('Max ISO Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
